title: GBAuto Agent OS expert ownership registry v1
description: ADR-03 contract: exactly one owner expert per first-class domain, one primary domain per expert. Registry-level registered_domains enumerates every first-class domain; entries bind each domain to its single owner expert. New domain without new expert fails closed in CI. Each entry may also attribute the contracts (schemas/*.schema.json) it owns; a contract has exactly one owner, mirroring the domain rule. Cross-entry contract uniqueness and on-disk contract coverage are not expressible in JSON Schema and are enforced by scripts/validate_expert_ownership.py. Each entry may also attribute the repo paths it owns via 'owned_paths'; a path has exactly one owner, mirroring the contract rule. Coverage of declared path_ownership_roots is opt-in and enforced by the validator.

path_ownership_roots.description: Roots under which EVERY direct child must be owned by exactly one expert. Opt-in: an empty or absent list enforces nothing, so coverage can be raised one root at a time instead of failing the whole tree at once.

contract_path.description: Repo-relative path to a versioned JSON Schema contract under schemas/, e.g. 'schemas/source-event.v1.schema.json'.

contracts.description: Contracts this expert owns. Optional: an entry may own no contract. Unique WITHIN the entry by schema; uniqueness ACROSS the registry, and the requirement that every schemas/*.v1.schema.json on disk is attributed exactly once, are enforced by scripts/validate_expert_ownership.py.

owned_paths.description: Repo paths this expert owns. Optional: an entry may own no path. Unique WITHIN the entry; uniqueness ACROSS the registry, existence on disk, and full coverage of any declared path_ownership_roots are enforced by validate_expert_ownership.py, mirroring the contract rules.

owned_path.description: Repo-relative path (file or directory) this expert owns. Unlike 'contracts' it is not restricted to schemas/, because ownable things live all over the tree: registries, runners, catalogs, and skill directories.
